description: Creates competitive battlecards for sales deal conversations. Produces win themes, landmines to plant, objection handlers, and competitive positioning per competitor. Outputs a structured markdown battlecard with quick-reference sections for live sales calls. Depends on competitor-research for competitive intelligence and consumes product-messaging, win-loss-analysis, and positioning for framing. Feeds into sales-deck, outreach-emails, and demo-script. Triggered by "battlecard", "competitive intel", "win against [competitor]", or "how do we beat [competitor]".
